title: Certificate in the Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence
description: The Certificate in the Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence provides students with a foundational understanding of the mathematical and algorithmic properties of methods used in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, and neural networks.
admission_criteria: The certificate is open to all degree-seeking students.
Students who are not part of an engineering professional program should contact a CSE advisor for permission.
completion_requirements: Students must complete 12 credit hours of required coursework listed below.
A combined GPA of 3.0 or better must be earned across all courses used to satisfy the certificate requirements.
The certificate is awarded concurrently with an undergraduate degree.
